page.content:
LEGOLAND Police is a subtheme of LEGOLAND (Theme). There were ten sets released from 1972 until 1977. Many of the sets from this theme were either police cars, helicopters, or stations.

What is LEGOLAND Police?

LEGOLAND Police is a subtheme of LEGOLAND (Theme). There were ten sets released from 1972 until 1977. Many of the sets from this theme were either police cars, helicopters, or stations.
